items.issues: 'Salt covers; it also keeps' + wrapping the shard like best linen maps cleanly to D; A/B/C each attach to a real passage detail. Solid medium.
'Steps around it as one steps around a sleeper' seals A; C is a decent misread of 'nothing has changed'; D is the weakest distractor (too generic).
'Not yet' when offered a match rules out A cleanly; B is the only reading that uses both preparation and restraint. Leans easy-medium.
Broken-and-glued teapot moved after a rumor is near-explicit for C; D (strict rules) is a weak distractor. Leans easy-medium.
'Gift or tether' is stated outright, so D is almost a paraphrase; C is tempting via 'longed to fish' but describes the speaker, not the net. B invents backstory.
'Light but certain' plus letting the bus pass gives C directly; A is the standard negative-connotation trap. Easy.
'No stitch showed… though both could feel its ridge' is the whole answer; A inverts the neatness, B/C contradict the felt ridge. Leans easy-medium.
Figurative phrase is nearly literal; C and D are off-topic rather than tempting, and D is noticeably longer/more specific than the others. Easy.
The sentence glosses itself ('rings recording the debts'); B is the literal-ledger trap, A the money trap. Easy.
'Locked' + 'washed ashore' + 'wanted the key' points straight to D; A/C take 'chest' literally, B misreads the mother's motive. Easy.
'Tired of hearing it… clicked her tongue' → 'said quietly… did not count anything' matches C; B tempts via the hurrying boy but the ending refutes it. Good medium.
Laughter → 'went pale… set the scissors down without a word… slowly unpick' is D; C is the opposite action, A overshoots the emotion. Good medium.
'Armed with silence' → shared tea and 'game set down' is A; B/C each hijack a surface detail (chess, the man). Leans easy-medium.
'(mocking)' → '(quietly) It's heavier than I thought' makes B obvious; D contradicts the action, A misassigns the shift to Linton. Easy.
Procedure list → 'I was not a kind judge… to be judged' is C; distractors are clearly wrong but attach to real details (evaluation, bailiff, successor). Leans easy-medium.
Rehearsed speech + 'exaggerated care' → 'speech went somewhere I could not follow' is D; B is the trap for readers who assume the speech was delivered. Good medium.
'Proud to keep a secret' → 'I am asking you to tell her' is A; B overreads the refused visas as accusation, D inverts the resolution. Good medium.
'Laughed the whole way' → 'neither of us has said a word… weigh this much' is B; A reverses the direction, D invents a refusal. Easy.
'Clever detours… pretending nothing was missing' → trading one note 'softer and softer' is C; B invents removal, A invents rivalry. Good medium.
